diagnostic.A: original full per-material buffers and original selected index stream
diagnostic.B: contiguous spatial runs; <=512 corners and <=2x2 parent-grid centroid cells
diagnostic.key0: A/B only; freeze motion, reset warmup/timing; no pose change
diagnostic.selection: same GRID selector and exactly same ordered face/strip stream in both modes
diagnostic.viewport: full Canvas; unchanged Image target and projection
diagnostic.alpha: original per-image threshold, cutout ON; no disable control
diagnostic.river: same four cached original frames/speed6/mode7/depth-write false; original order
diagnostic.geometry_texture_uploads: cold only; both layouts resident, no geometry/index/texture allocation on A/B switch at warmed fixed masks
diagnostic.visibility_masks: two-entry cache per parent, lazy compact index cache; no whole-room OOM substitution
diagnostic.metrics: fractional FPS; N/C/I ms; T selected triangles; D calls; VB sum submitted buffer capacities; S selected corners; RES both resident layouts
diagnostic.failure: optional compact build OOM disables B but preserves A; render failure releases target; explicit A recovery, never silently labelled B

purpose: Test vertex-buffer-capacity hypothesis on the same city geometry. More compact buffers trade extra calls for smaller submitted capacities; no FPS gain or full-VB driver processing claimed.
